text:
Swift cold hands
+
+remove one by one
+
+the bandages of shadow
+
+
+I open my eyes
+
+still
+
+I am alive
+
+at the center
+
+of a still-fresh wound.

translation.title: Daybreak
translation.editorial_note: Todavía is first temporal and then adjectival through still and still-fresh; waking becomes survival inside the wound opened by dawn.
